attchmntText: Jai Balaji Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Jai Balaji Industries Limited filed an investor presentation with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited on November 17, 2026. The company reported Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs. 1,652 crore, a 22% year-over-year increase. Adjusted EBITDA rose 93% to Rs. 135 crore, and PAT increased 192% to Rs. 77 crore. The presentation highlighted a 51% year-over-year improvement in Ferro Alloys realizations. Capex totaling Rs. 1,112 crore is being funded through internal accruals and is scheduled for completion by November 2026. Enhanced capacities for Blast Furnace, Sinter, and Specialized Ferro Alloys are expected to be commissioned by Q4 FY27. Net Term Debt-to-Equity stood at 0.06x in FY26. The company also noted an expanded DI Pipes capacity of 5.5 lakh TPA.

attchmntText: Jai Balaji Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Jai Balaji Industries Limited has intimated that a conference call to discuss Q2 and H1FY27 results is scheduled for Tuesday, November 17th, 2026, at 3:00 PM IST. The call is hosted by Go India Advisors. Participants include Chairman and Managing Director Aditya Jajodia, Joint Chief Financial Officer Raj Kr Sharma, President Finance Vijay Kr. Bagri, and Company Secretary Ajay Kumar Tantia. The company stated that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared during the call. The date of the meeting may be subject to change due to exigencies.
